description: Two tall-masted sailing ships with dark, tattered sails lit orange from within are on a rough, stormy sea under heavy clouds, with rocky cliffs at both edges. The larger ship on the left has figures on its deck and a lantern glow, and the smaller ship on the right flies a Union Jack. The only mark is a small white sparkle logo in the bottom-right corner.
reason: Shows two sailing ships in a storm at sea, but the card is a surgery performed under general anaesthesia in Japan in 1804; nothing in the picture relates to surgery or medicine.
